results.text: Association Between Alpha-1 Adrenoreceptor Antagonist Use and Cognitive Impairment: A Systematic Review. Alpha-1 adrenergic receptor (α1-AR) antagonists are commonly used for management of benign prostatic hyperplasia or hypertension. Some studies have shown a potential link between α1-AR antagonist use and cognitive impairment.
